_comment: Add some variability to avoid synchronized agent falls
_comment_wp_radius: This is the radius around the waypoint where agents can be considered as having reached it
_comment_model_constants: Model constants reported in the paper; defaults equal the previously hard-coded values
_comment_model: 'hazard': P = h r_space(x) r_time(t) c(s,alpha) per update, h = update_time/tau_line, r_time = 1 + lambda t/T, c = 1 - gamma(2alpha-1)(2s-1). 'legacy': survival form of the submitted manuscript (uses p_min, p_max, survival_noise, crowding_model).
_comment_firing_line: Endpoints of the shooters' line in simulation coordinates (m), following the firing line on Wagner's map
